title: Control-plane objective
body: Build a centralized command center for multi-agent software development with explicit orchestration, shared memory, and deterministic verification.

title: ADR-001 Use capability-first provider routing
body: Agents request capabilities instead of vendor names. Provider selection is resolved by registry + project bindings + fallback chains.

title: Structured handoffs required
body: All inter-agent outputs must validate against shared zod schemas in @cp/domain.
